03 / Pricing

One inclusive customer total in AUD

Example: a $10 source item and $4 in other costs produces a $15 inclusive total under the first policy, or $11 under the second. The second leaves a $3 loss before other overheads. Cost amounts must be confirmed for the order; they are not automatically estimated.
